method:
Hand review of ClinicalTrials.gov studies on stopping or stepping down semaglutide/tirzepatide.
Input: ops/data/glp1-stopping/ctgov-raw.json (from ops/scripts/glp1_stopping_ctgov.py; 1,006 studies, keyword hits).
Each keyword hit was read by hand (title, summary, arms, outcomes); the kept list and categories are below.
STEP 1 (NCT03548935, off-treatment extension) and STEP 4 (NCT03548987) were added by hand: their registry text
does not use stopping/withdrawal words, so the keyword pass missed them.
Re-fetches each kept record for live status/results, extracts posted results for NCT05548647 (Study 2) and NCT06640972,
and writes site/research/sources/glp1-stopping-ctgov-2026-10-19.json. Jabbit analysis, 2026-10-19 (ET).

Study 2 Past-week Hunger as Measured Usi.time_frame: S2: Week 72 endpoint controlling for S1 baseline
Study 2 Past-week Hunger as Measured Usi.description: Secondary confirmatory outcome (Study 2): Visual analogue scale rating of hunger during the past week (Control of Eating Questionnaire; COEQ). Score range 0-100 mm. Higher scores indicate greater hunger.

Study 2 Past-week Fullness After Meals a.time_frame: S2: Week 72 endpoint controlling for S1 baseline
Study 2 Past-week Fullness After Meals a.description: Secondary confirmatory outcome (Study 2): Visual analogue scale rating of fullness after meals during the past week (Control of Eating Questionnaire; COEQ). Score range 0-100 mm. Higher scores indicate greater fullness after meals.

Study 2 Past-week Food Preoccupation as.time_frame: S2: Week 72 endpoint controlling for S1 baseline
Study 2 Past-week Food Preoccupation as.description: Secondary confirmatory outcome (Study 2): Visual analogue scale rating of food preoccupation during the past week (Control of Eating Questionnaire; COEQ). Score range 0-100 mm. Higher scores indicate greater food preoccupation.

Study 2 Explicit Responsiveness to the F.time_frame: S2: Week 72 endpoint controlling for S1 baseline
Study 2 Explicit Responsiveness to the F.description: Secondary confirmatory outcome (Study 2): Explicit responsiveness to the food environment measured by the summary score of the Power of Food Scale (15-item version). Score range 1-5. Higher scores indicate greater responsiveness to the food environment.

Study 2 Implicit Food Wanting of High-fa.time_frame: S2: Week 72 endpoint controlling for S1 baseline
Study 2 Implicit Food Wanting of High-fa.description: Secondary confirmatory outcome (Study 2): Implicit food wanting of high-fat, savory foods measured using the Leeds Food Preference Task. Scores range from -100 to +100 with higher scores indicating a greater implicit wanting of high-fat savory foods.

Study 2 Body Weight (kg).time_frame: S2: Week 72 endpoint controlling for S1 baseline
Study 2 Body Weight (kg).description: Supportive secondary outcome (Study 2): Body weight (kg) at week 72

Incremental Postprandial Triglycerides (.description: Mean percent change in incremental TG area under the curve (AUC) from baseline to week 12. Samples were collected at 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8-hours hours post dose.

Body Weight.description: Mean percent change in body weight from baseline to week 12. Samples were collected at 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8-hours hours post dose.

5% Increase in Body Weight.description: Percentage of patients exhibiting at least a 5% increase from baseline to Week 12.

LDL-C.description: Mean percent change from baseline to week 12. Samples were collected at 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8-hours hours post dose.

notes: Keyword searches can miss studies whose registry text never says stop, withdraw, taper or maintain (STEP 1 and STEP 4 were added by hand for that reason).

Excluded keyword hits: stopping smoking or alcohol, pausing the drug before surgery or endoscopy, bariatric-surgery regain treated with a GLP-1, other drugs' maintenance trials, and studies where 'maintenance' meant the maintenance dose.
